payload.title: Which hyp commit implements the hold rule?
payload.body: Each Hypothesis is one commit on feat/reading-hold. Its rival is the base afe2c1f1e9cad835edb755b6c08deaae279afd1b: each new test of lines 1, 2, 3 and 6 is red on the base and green on the candidate, and the tests of lines 4 and 5 are green on both.

why: The build question of the Goal; the run adds one Hypothesis per commit.

payload.summary: Grill of #174 done: Goal G-5W1F5S with six lines and one build question; base afe2c1f. The owner settled the hold rule, inconclusive reach, the write refusals of add hyp, supersede and abandon, and the edge kinds in the session.
